messages.subject: Project Falcon - revised SSA (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Attached is our revised draft (v3, redline against v2). We've moved the founder cap to £3.5m, de minimis to £35k, basket to £350k and general warranty survival to 2 years (tax remains 7). With the 18-month non-compete already agreed, we believe this closes out the open commercial points. Subject to your confirmation we'll prepare the execution version.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
